detaileddescription.para: This namespace has three main classes and a number of auxiliary classes. The main classes are:

listitem.para: Definition describes a particular calling convention based on external documentation of that calling convention.
Dictionary is a collection of calling convention definitions.
Analysis performs an analysis and can determine which definitions best match the characteristics of some specified function.
Declaration takes a calling convention definition and a C-like function prototype and outputs locations where each argument would be stored.
